remarks: HEAT and HOT WATER INCLUDED in RENT. Welcome to Rolling Ridge, a serene, park-like community set amid beautiful grounds. Enjoy winding walking paths, a picturesque pond with fountains, a fabulous pool area, and a paddle tennis court. Rolling Ridge offers a tranquil setting while remaining conveniently close to everything Norwalk and the surrounding areas have to offer. This refreshed, ranch-style two-bedroom condominium features brand-new vinyl flooring in the kitchen. along with freshly painted living room and hallway. The spacious open-concept living room flows seamlessly into a dedicated dining area, with sliding doors leading to a private deck overlooking a peaceful view in the complex. Additional highlights include an in-unit laundry closet, 2 additional hallway closets, two assigned parking spaces plus ample visitor parking, and Heat, Hot Water and water included in the rent. Ideally located in a prime Norwalk setting, just minutes from Calf Pasture Beach, Cranbury Park, historic SoNo, public golf courses, schools, shopping, Metro-North train stations, major highways, and more. Approximately 50 miles to Midtown Manhattan. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy comfortable living in a sought-after, amenity-rich Norwalk community. Small PETS ok. Agents, please see remarks.
